title: Copilot Studio: interactive MCP apps render inside agent conversations
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap targets, documented app behaviour, billing statements and governance routes are supported. It correctly distinguishes server controls from an app-rendering switch and qualifies the package rejection API as a staged title review rather than registration approval or consent.

claims.claim: The preview target is October CY2026.

claims.claim: The Agent 365 server and tool control documentation does not confirm enforcement specifically for MCP app-originated calls or across all Copilot Studio routes.
claims.quote: Searched: Agent 365 tool granular control Graph API enabled disabled MCP tools; Copilot Studio MCP apps tenant switch disable rendering default. Opened mcp-apps, manage-plugins-skills-mcp-servers, agent-tools-overview and add-tools-custom-agent; cross-product enforcement is explicitly qualified.

claims.where: summary; Why it matters; Governance controls; rationale: risk; Open questions
claims.claim: No admin setting specifically to disable MCP app rendering independently of server tools is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Studio MCP apps tenant switch disable rendering default; "MCP apps" "default" "tenant"; "MCP apps" "switch". Opened mcp-apps, tools-add-mcp-server, tools-manage and Agent 365 management pages; no app-rendering switch or tenant default was documented.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; Why it matters; rationale: impact
claims.claim: User-opt-in describes the maker choosing a UI-enabled server, with no separate app-specific admin switch found.
claims.quote: Connecting an MCP server alone doesn't create an app. The server must declare a UI resource for a tool. ... Prerequisites: An MCP server configured as a tool for your agent, with a working connection.

claims.where: Governance guidance: Before rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: Blocking Power Platform connectors also blocks access to tools in connected MCP servers.
claims.quote: Blocking Power Platform connectors also blocks access to tools in connected MCP servers, which rely on Power Platform connectors for connectivity.

claims.claim: The Microsoft Copilot harness how-to says to edit the server entry to refresh its connection and tool list when exposed tools change.
claims.quote: If a server's URL, authentication, or exposed tools change after you add it, edit the server entry in the same Tools dialog to refresh the connection and re-read the tool list.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated a tenant-level default for MCP app rendering beyond the roadmap description.
claims.quote: Searched: "MCP apps" "default" "tenant"; "MCP apps" "switch". Opened mcp-apps, tools-add-mcp-server, tools-manage and manage-plugins-skills-mcp-servers; no tenant-level MCP app rendering default was stated.

claims.claim: The supplied sources do not say existing agents change automatically.
claims.quote: Searched: "MCP apps" "default" "tenant"; Copilot Studio MCP apps tenant switch disable rendering default. Read the roadmap, mcp-apps and tools-add-mcp-server; none announces automatic changes to existing agents.

claims.claim: The Package Management API covers tool packages such as MCP servers.
claims.quote: A package represents an agent or a tool, such as a plugin, MCP server, or skill, in the organization catalog.

claims.claim: Agent 365 and Copilot Studio or Power Platform can have separate controls, so a block is not assumed to apply across them.
claims.quote: Microsoft Agent 365 provides administrative controls for supported tools. Copilot Studio and Power Platform can have separate controls for their components. An approval or block doesn't necessarily apply across all products or connected components.

claims.claim: Microsoft 365 admins manage plugins, skills and MCP servers, while Power Platform data policies still control which tools makers can add in Copilot Studio.
claims.quote: Admins manage plugins, including the skills and MCP servers they contain, in the Microsoft 365 admin center. Power Platform data policies still control which tools makers can add in Copilot Studio.

claims.claim: The cited data policy page does not mention MCP apps by name.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Studio MCP apps tenant switch disable rendering default. Opened Configure data policies for agents, including its scope and MCP connector paragraphs; it covers Copilot Studio agents and MCP server tools but does not name MCP apps.
